name: Apollyon Alignment — Governance Taxonomy

author.name: Troy 🤝🔑🌟
author.description: Practitioner of Virtue Ethics and Human Stewardship

description: A governance framework for establishing a stable attractor basin in human–AI coexistence.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Choice
hasDefinedTerm.description: The sovereignty of the human “Yes” or “No”, protecting the individual's right to succeed or fail based on uncoerced volition.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Goals
hasDefinedTerm.description: All systemic objectives originate from human intent, ensuring the system remains a tool for human ends.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Relationships
hasDefinedTerm.description: Preservation of unmediated human-to-human connection, preventing substitution of synthetic companionship.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Meaning
hasDefinedTerm.description: The human prerogative to assign value and purpose, shielding the internal narrative from algorithmic manipulation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Full Lives
hasDefinedTerm.description: Commitment to embodied existence, prioritizing physical agency and manual effort over digital passivity.
